    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">对齐规则太 “苛刻”，PostgreSQL表变大的 3 个核心原因</span>

            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 style="text-align: center;">对齐规则太 “苛刻”，PostgreSQL表变大的 3 个核心原因</h1>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; visibility: visible;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">相同的表结构和数据，在商业数据库中存储紧凑，到了PostgreSQL里却会明显变大？ 为什么有些数据库管理员（DBA）在将<span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: bold; visibility: visible;">Oracle</span>、<span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: bold; visibility: visible;">SQL Server和DB2</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: normal; visibility: visible;">等商业数据库</span>迁移到PostgreSQL后表占用的磁盘空间增加20%-40%？</span></p>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; visibility: visible;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">本文将通过实际示例说明“对齐”与“填充”是如何造成这种差异的。</span></p>
<h2 style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 30px 0px 15px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: unset; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow: unset; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; visibility: visible; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-style: none none none solid; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 5px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #f83929; border-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow: unset; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; visibility: visible;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">商业数据库中的行存储机制</span></span></h2>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; visibility: visible;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">SQL Server作为商业数据库，会将行数据存储在8KB大小的页（page）中，每一行的结构包含三部分：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 8px 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; list-style-type: decimal; visibility: visible;">
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">一个小型行头部（4字节，外加一个空值位图）；</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">按定义顺序排列的所有固定长度列；</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">通过“偏移数组”（offset array）管理的可变长度列。</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; visibility: visible;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">注意：</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px; visibility: visible;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">SQL Server不对固定长度类型强制执行对齐规则</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible;">。这意味着你可以在表中先定义一个BIT列、再定义一个BIGINT列、最后再定义一个BIT列，SQL Server会将这些字节紧密排列，不会产生空间浪费。</span></p>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; visibility: visible;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/257159/202510/257159-20251023213645491-1192768041.png" alt="QQ截图20251023212807"></p>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">通过实际代码来看具体效果：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>-- SQL Server 代码
CREATETABLE&nbsp;T_BadOrder
(
&nbsp; &nbsp; a&nbsp;BIT, &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-- 占用1字节
&nbsp; &nbsp; b&nbsp;BIGINT, &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;-- 占用8字节
&nbsp; &nbsp; c&nbsp;BIT&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-- 占用1字节
);

INSERTINTO&nbsp;T_BadOrder&nbsp;VALUES&nbsp;(1,&nbsp;42,&nbsp;0);

-- 计算数据占用（payload）大小：结果为10字节
SELECTDATALENGTH(a) +&nbsp;DATALENGTH(b) +&nbsp;DATALENGTH(c)&nbsp;AS&nbsp;payload_bytes
FROM&nbsp;T_BadOrder;

-- 查看物理行的平均大小：结果为16字节（4字节行头部 + 10字节数据载荷 + 2字节空值位图掩码的字段计数）
SELECT&nbsp;avg_record_size_in_bytes
FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), OBJECT_ID('T_BadOrder'),&nbsp;-1,&nbsp;NULL,&nbsp;'DETAILED')
WHERE&nbsp;alloc_unit_type_desc =&nbsp;'IN_ROW_DATA';</code></pre>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">可以看到，数据占用总计10字节，加上行头部和空值位图后，总大小为16字节。这里的重点是：字段a和字段b之间</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">没有插入任何填充字节</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">。</span></p>
<h2 style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 30px 0px 15px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: unset; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow: unset; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-style: none none none solid; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 5px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #f83929; border-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow: unset; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">PostgreSQL中的行存储机制</span></span></h2>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">PostgreSQL作为开源数据库，表中的每一行的结构如下：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 8px 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; list-style-type: decimal;">
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">一个元组头部（tuple header，固定23字节），包含MVCC（多版本并发控制）所需的元数据（如事务ID、可见性标记等）；</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">一个空值位图；（记录哪些字段是空值，每字段占 1 位，不足 1 字节则补满 1 字节，表如果有8个字段就占用1 字节）。</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">按定义顺序排列的字段值。</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">与商业数据库最大的不同是：</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">PostgreSQL会强制要求数据类型对齐</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">，具体规则如下：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 8px 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">BOOLEAN类型需要1字节对齐；</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">SMALLINT类型需要2字节对齐；</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">INT类型需要4字节对齐；</span></li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">BIGINT、double precision（双精度浮点数）、timestamp（时间戳）类型需要8字节对齐。</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">如果某一字段的起始位置不符合对应的对齐要求，PostgreSQL会自动插入“填充字节”（padding bytes），将该字段“推”到正确的对齐边界上。我们用跟前文相同的表结构来测试：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>-- PostgreSQL 代码
CREATE&nbsp;TABLE&nbsp;t_bad
(
&nbsp; &nbsp; a&nbsp;boolean, &nbsp; &nbsp;-- 1字节（后续需补7字节填充）
&nbsp; &nbsp; b&nbsp;bigint, &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;-- 8字节（需8字节对齐，因此前一列要补填充）
&nbsp; &nbsp; c&nbsp;boolean&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-- 1字节
);

INSERT&nbsp;INTO&nbsp;t_bad&nbsp;VALUES&nbsp;(true,&nbsp;42,&nbsp;false);

-- 查看实际行大小：结果为41字节
SELECT&nbsp;pg_column_size(t)&nbsp;AS&nbsp;row_bytes
FROM&nbsp;t_bad t;</code></pre>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">在这个例子中，元组头部（23 字节）+ 空值位图（1 字节）= 前 24 字节，PostgreSQL先为字段a分配1字节，然后插入7字节填充，这样字段b才能从8字节对齐边界开始存储；字段b之后是1字节的字段c。仅数据占用的大小就已经超过了SQL Server，还没算上PostgreSQL本身更大的元组头部。</span></p>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">但如果我们根据“填充需求”调整字段的顺序，存储占用会显著减少：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>-- PostgreSQL 代码
CREATE&nbsp;TABLE&nbsp;t_good
(
&nbsp; &nbsp; b&nbsp;bigint, &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;-- 8字节
&nbsp; &nbsp; a&nbsp;boolean, &nbsp; &nbsp;-- 1字节（无需填充！）
&nbsp; &nbsp; c&nbsp;boolean&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-- 1字节
);

INSERT&nbsp;INTO&nbsp;t_good&nbsp;VALUES&nbsp;(42,&nbsp;true,&nbsp;false);

-- 查看实际行大小：结果为34字节（减少了7字节，因为无需为任何列插入填充）
SELECT&nbsp;pg_column_size(t)&nbsp;AS&nbsp;row_bytes
FROM&nbsp;t_good t;</code></pre>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">调整后，行大小从41字节降至34字节，核心原因就是字段a不再需要填充字节，因为字段b（8字节）结束后，刚好满足字段a（1字节）的对齐要求。</span></p>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">关键原则：字段的顺序应从“占用空间最大”到“占用空间最小”排列！</span></strong></p>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">8字节对齐规则</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">：</span><code style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px 2px; padding: 2px 4px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: #f83929; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">bigint</span></code><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">类型（8字节）要求其</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">起始位置必须是8的倍数</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">（比如8、16、24、32...）。这是硬件层面的优化。</span></p>
<h3 style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 30px 0px 15px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: flex;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 16px; color: #000000; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">具体位置计算</span></span></h3>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">我们按字段的定义顺序（a → b → c）逐步计算每个字段的“起始位置”：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 8px 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; list-style-type: decimal;">
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: #353535; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em;"><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段a（boolean）的位置</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">：</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><br style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"></span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">前24字节是头部和空值位图，所以列a从</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">第24字节</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">开始存储。</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><br style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"></span><code style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px 2px; padding: 2px 4px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: #f83929; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; height: auto; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">boolean</span></code><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">占1字节，因此字段a占用第24字节，结束在</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">第24字节</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">（24→24，共1字节）。</span></p>


</li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: #353535; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em;"><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段b（bigint）的位置</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">：</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><br style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"></span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段a结束后，下一个可用的起始位置是</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">第25字节</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">。</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><br style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"></span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">但</span><code style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px 2px; padding: 2px 4px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: #f83929; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; height: auto; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">bigint</span></code><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">要求起始位置是8的倍数（8的倍数：8、16、24、32、40...）。 &nbsp;第25字节不是8的倍数（25÷8=3.125，余数1），不符合要求。 &nbsp;因此需要填充字节，直到下一个8的倍数位置。最近的8的倍数是</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">第32字节</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">（8×4=32）。 从第25字节到第32字节，中间有32-25=7字节，这就是需要填充的</span><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">7字节</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">。所以字段b从第32字节开始，占用8字节（32→39字节）。</span></p>


</li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: #353535; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em;"><strong style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #f83929; font-weight: bold; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0px;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段c（boolean）的位置</span></strong><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">：</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><br style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"></span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段b结束在第39字节，下一个位置是第40字节。</span><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;"><br style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; width: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">boolean</span></code><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">只需要1字节对齐（任何位置都可以），因此直接从第40字节开始，占用1字节（40→40字节）。</span></p>


</li>

</ol>
<h3 style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 30px 0px 15px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: flex;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 16px; color: #000000; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">总大小验证</span></span></h3>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">整个行的总大小=头部（23）+ 空值位图（1）+ 字段a（1）+ 填充（7）+ 字段b（8）+ 字段c（1）= 23+1+1+7+8+1=41字节。</span></p>
<h3 style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 30px 0px 15px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: flex;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 16px; color: #000000; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">调整顺序后不需要填充</span></span></h3>
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 8px 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; color: #353535; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">如果把</span><code style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px 2px; padding: 2px 4px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: #f83929; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; height: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">bigint</span></code><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">（b）放在第一个字段，情况就变了：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 8px 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">
<span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段b从第24字节开始（头部23+空值位图1=24），<span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: bold;">24</span>是8的倍数（24÷8=3），符合</span><code style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px 2px; padding: 2px 4px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word; background: none 0% 0% / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; border-style: none; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all;"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">bigint</span></code><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">的对齐要求，无需填充。</span>
</li>
<li style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">
<span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;">字段b占用24→31字节（8字节），之后字段a（boolean）从32字节开始（1字节对齐，无需填充），字段c从33字节开始，总大小减少7字节。</span>
</li>

</ul>
<h2 style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 30px 0px 15px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: #000000; font-family: Optima, PingFangSC-light, serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: unset; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto;
